The '''Flex Tube proton torpedo launcher''' was a model of [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launcher]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. A pair of the launchers were installed on [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]]. Located beneath the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], the launchers were concealed by [[Armor/Legends|armored]] doors that slid open once the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] or [[Weapons officer/Legends|weapons officer]] activated them. The launchers were fed from a central magazine, allowing either launcher to fire all eight loaded [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]].<ref name="SWS" />

The Flex Tube launcher was notable for its ability to fire a wide variety of ordnance, including proton torpedoes, [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]] and [[Cluster missile/Legends|cluster missiles]].
